lead: Manscaped is a San Diego direct-to-consumer brand of men's grooming tools, founded in 2016 by Paul Tran and Steve King, best known for the Lawn Mower electric trimmer for body and pubic hair.[1][2]

The brand built its profile on humour-driven advertising and the term "manscaping." Wikipedia records a 2018 Shark Tank appearance, a 2020 campaign with Rob Gronkowski, and a terminated 2021 SPAC merger at about a $1 billion valuation.[1] Grokipedia reports 2020 sales of $65 million, and criticism of pricing and trim-guard durability.[2]
No clinical studies of the trimmers were found.

paras: The company launched its Lawn Mower trimmer in 2016 and pitched on Shark Tank in 2018, reaching a handshake offer that did not close.[1][2] A planned SPAC merger announced in November 2021 was terminated in August 2022.[1][2] It entered Boots stores in the UK and Ireland in 2023.[2]

Grokipedia reports 2023 reviews describing a premium price for trimmers similar to cheaper alternatives, reports of trim guards detaching, and trademark or patent disputes including a 2019 suit by Wahl Clipper.[2] Critics also argue the marketing promotes grooming insecurity, per the same source.[2]
